name: Login always uses persistent storage without Remember Me checkbox
description: When a user logs in, the 'Remember Me' checkbox is no longer present, and the user successfully authenticates and lands on the dashboard.

planSteps.description: Verify the 'مرا به خاطر بسپار' (Remember Me) checkbox is no longer visible on the login form
Enter valid credentials (e.g. username 'saman_admin' and password '123456') and submit the form
Verify the user is successfully redirected to the dashboard and the main panel is visible
